subject.title: fix(codex): continue after source-reply delivery instead of terminating turn

question: Should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 become the canonical fix, with live channel proof required before merge?
rationale: Both branches address the same current regression with similar code and neither has positive real-channel proof, so automation cannot safely choose the canonical contribution or waive the message-delivery proof gate.

options.title: Sponsor this PR after proof
options.body: Use this narrower two-file branch as canonical after rebasing and adding a live Discord/Codex continuation and no-duplicate transcript.

options.title: Sponsor the competing PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 as canonical if its additional schema wording is preferred, subject to the same live proof requirement.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Keep both candidates unmerged until a maintainer or contributor can produce a representative live channel run.

recommendation.title: Sponsor this PR after proof
recommendation.body: Use this narrower two-file branch as canonical after rebasing and adding a live Discord/Codex continuation and no-duplicate transcript.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes the Codex source-reply completion behavior introduced in their merged work.
